samplerContract.expand: ShapeParameters::expand(amount); cross-section expansion, NOT rise/slope; decays expand*(1-t) to0

semantics.inputs: native position XYZ, rank1..3, width, rise, expansion; roof sampler, host render slot, sideWalls bool. Quaternion/scale of passed transform are not consulted by original strip core.
semantics.rng: wyhash64 state seed = trunc(f32Length(f32(position*10))); splits consume interior draws, tile tilt consumes one, every output consumes signed[-100,99] with 200 range rejection threshold96; interleaving is mandatory.
semantics.order: row ascending; column ascending; row0 front; main tile; col0 left trim + optional left fill; lastcol right trim + optional right fill
semantics.front: row0 horizontal strip with axes[-normal.z,0,normal.x],inwardNormal,+Y; sagitta across entire row span gives height max(sagitta+.1,.3); centered midAB+inward*height/2
semantics.fill: baseY=min(sourceY0,sourceY1)-.1; height B.y-baseY; width XZsegment length; shift normal±.08; side0 q*rotY180; clip cross(B-A,normal), -dot(B,clipN); no normalization
semantics.format64: position0f32x3; pad12; clip16f16x4; scale24f16x3; pad30; quat32f16x4; slot40u32; pad44; 48f32=1;52i32ordinal;56/60zero

exactSemantics.clampedY: v=clamp((y + noise(x*.5,z*.5)*(-.3) - baseY)/((baseY+height)-baseY),0,1), everyscalar stepf32. Do not simplify denominator toheight.
exactSemantics.section: profile inversepower and expandedDimensions from existing recoveredmath. No tipOffset reads in section function.
exactSemantics.rectangleClosest: Nearest projected worldsegment Euclidean distance, strictless tie order0..3; firstdistance capped1000; projectiondenominator at least f32(1e-20). This is native behavior even for distant queries.
exactSemantics.circleCurve: N=max(3,ceil(perimeter/.2)), N points over u=i/(N-1). ThusN includesclosed endpoint, not N+1.
exactSemantics.fullFrameU: Analytic shape.closestU and shape.perimeter first. rank2 offset=f32(f32(width/perimeter)*.25);rank3=f32(f32(width/perimeter)/3). Then polyline sample/tangent at wrapped U.
exactSemantics.fullRank3Middle: Uses curve.sample(centerU) position, cached quaternion, unit scale.
exactSemantics.yaw: tangent-normal n=normalize([-t.z,0,t.x]); xzProjectiveRotation renormalizesXZ, fallback+X; horizontalaxis SIMD Y signedzero preserved.
exactSemantics.padding: Transform48 final8bytes and shape28 circlelast8bytes are padding, not semantic geometry.

hostAdapter.classification: Host editor contract, not a recovered Tiny Glade UI behavior
hostAdapter.coordinates: Normalized oriented footprint rectangle UV; vertical highest hit on the original GothicSupportMesh triangles. Empty circle corners and horizontal caps fail explicitly. Native UV is diagnostic derived evidence, not saved author state.
hostAdapter.sharedFacing: GothicPlacement.gothicRoofFacing; original arithmetic extracted without changes. Raising bottom retains surface-facing orientation.
hostAdapter.resizing: Host scale [XZ,Y] changes original frame arc spacing, model transforms, individual opening offsets/extents, strip width/rise/expansion together. Scale [1,1] preserves native byte parity. This extension is not evidence of arbitrary-size controls in Tiny Glade.
hostAdapter.verification: PitchedRoofAttachment.spec.ts: rotated rectangles/circles, nonzero circle tip, chart seam, topmost cap rejection, empty corners, bottom raise, all three resized ranks, generated Cottage cuts through ConstructionRoof context.
hostAdapter.limits: The existing rectangular main-roof tile producer rejects nonzero tip, axis and edge mode. Placement tests exercise axis1 and tip; complete roof generation uses supported axis0. Full Cottage public generation is connected. Placement tests alone do not establish three-material/three-LOD visual acceptance; later browser records have their own explicit scopes.

sidePlane.classification: Host material replacement extension following the original roof plane compensation; no claim that Tiny Glade offers arbitrary material replacement.
sidePlane.nativeFormula: plane = half4(instance64[16..24]); plane.w += dot(preWarp - renderedPosition, plane.xyz); discard when dot(vec4(fragmentPosition,1),plane) < 0.
sidePlane.verification: RoofUnitClip.spec.ts; seven real WebGL2 original/SDF shader pairs linked; existing PlannedMasonryWorld decoration fixture passed. These do not establish full Cottage dormer visual parity.
